full_prompt_en: The image is a square color studio photograph of a woman shown in a strict right-facing profile against a nearly black background. Her short dark bob curves around the back of her head and ends near the jaw. Soft bangs cover part of the forehead. The forehead, nose, lips, and chin form one clean continuous silhouette against the dark field. Her eye looks steadily toward the unseen right side of the frame, and a bright red lip gives the face its strongest color accent. Warm side light from the right catches the cheekbone, bridge of the nose, eyelid, and neck. The far side of her hair and shoulder remains in deep shadow. A dark red high-neck garment covers the shoulders and lower frame, its folds visible only where small warm highlights strike. The background has almost no texture or contextual objects. Its blackness leaves ample negative space in front of the face, strengthening the direction of her gaze. The camera is placed level with the head and neither above nor below, preserving the clarity of the side contour. Skin appears smooth but not featureless, with gentle tonal modeling from illuminated cheek to darker jaw. The hair is a soft mass rather than a collection of individually sharp strands. Red fabric and lips echo each other without overwhelming the otherwise limited brown-black palette. There is no dramatic pose or action; the image is built on controlled orientation and quiet expression. The composition feels formal, spare, and intimate, emphasizing the precise relationship of lit facial edge, dark hair, warm red accent, and uninterrupted shadow space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色影棚照片，一位女子以严格向右的侧面立于近黑背景前。短深发在脑后弯曲，结束于下颌附近。柔软刘海遮住部分额头。额、鼻、唇与下巴在深域前连成一条干净剪影。她的眼稳稳望向画外右侧，鲜红嘴唇是脸上最强色彩重点。右侧暖侧光照到颧骨、鼻梁、眼睑与颈。远侧头发和肩留在深影里。深红高领衣服覆盖肩和下方画幅，只有小暖亮点落处才看见褶痕。背景几乎没有肌理或环境物体。黑暗在脸前留下宽阔留白，强化视线方向。相机与头同高，不俯也不仰，保持侧轮廓清晰。皮肤平顺却不空洞，从受光脸颊到较暗下颌有温和调子塑形。头发是柔和体块，而非根根锐利发丝。红衣与红唇互相呼应，没有压倒其余有限的褐黑配色。没有夸张姿势或动作；图像由受控方向和安静神情构成。构图正式、简练且亲密，强调受光脸边、深发、暖红重点与连续暗处之间的精确关系。
style_prompt_en: Controlled color photography isolates a sharply readable side contour against nearly featureless darkness. Warm directional light grazes high planes and transitions gently into deep shadow. Dark hair and clothing become broad soft masses, while one restrained red accent concentrates color. The frame leaves open negative space in the direction a form faces, making orientation a primary compositional line. Smooth skin tone retains mild natural variation instead of becoming flat. The camera stays level and close, with little environmental distraction. The effect is formal, quiet, and intimate, driven by silhouette, measured side light, and a very small palette.
style_prompt_zh: 受控的彩色摄影把清晰可辨的侧轮廓隔在几乎没有特征的黑暗前。暖定向光擦过高平面，并温和地退入深影。深发与衣服成为宽柔体块，一处克制红重点聚集色彩。画幅在形体面向方向留下开放空域，使朝向成为主要构图线。平顺肤色仍保有温和自然变化，而非平涂。镜头齐平且靠近，几乎没有环境干扰。效果正式、安静且亲密，由剪影、有尺度的侧光和极小配色推动。
theme_en: A woman with a short dark bob seen in clean right-facing profile against black
theme_zh: 一位短黑发女子以清晰的向右侧脸立于黑底前
name: Profile view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
